title: The Abyss That Looks Back
description:
Name: [The Leviathan](image:tumblrbumblr:textures/quests/photos/leviathan.png:150:150)
Known Locations: The Sunken City, located in the Abyssal Depths dimension, entered through Eye of Abyss.
Estimated Size: Huge
Behavior: Summoned through the usage of an [Abyssal Sacrifice](image:tumblrbumblr:textures/quests/abyssal_sacrifice.png:124:127). Fights exclusively underwater, filling the arena with Abyssal Mines that explode on contact, dealing damage and applying Abyssal Fear, stopping all healing for the opponent. Can also strike from a distance with her tongue and tentacles. Her strongest attack is grabbing her opponent with her tentacles and focusing a large laser beam on them for continuous damage. When brought to low health, she changes to Phase 2, regenerating half of her lost hp while releasing Homing Warps, which apply Abyssal Fear on contact. Abyssal Fear and Abyssal Burn can be negated through eating [Blessed Amethyst Crab Meat](image:tumblrbumblr:textures/quests/blessed_amethyst_crab_meat.png:133:67)
Danger Level: §8§lDeadly, recommended to bring an underwater weapon and Blessed Amethyst Crab Meat
